articles.title: Can GrowQR help me get a job?
articles.text:
Yes. GrowQR helps you build career readiness for a role, then get in front of it.
Your RQ Score sets the starting point and becomes your career roadmap:
• Skill gaps: see which skills are missing for your target role, and train on them
• Learning recommendations: a focused set of courses to close those gaps
• Resume and interviews: an ATS ready resume, plus mock interview practice
• Job matching: relevant roles, with auto apply on higher plans
As you progress, your career roadmap and RQ Score update.
Start free at growqr.ai

articles.title: Does GrowQR work for universities and institutes?
articles.text:
Yes. GrowQR helps universities and institutes improve employability and placements.
Students get the full agent suite for career pathways, skill building, resumes, and mock interviews. The institution gets readiness visibility across cohorts through RQ Scores, plus recruiter engagement to help place students.
You can read more at growqr.ai/solutions/institutes. If you would like to explore a campus partnership or a demo, I can take a few details and connect you with our team.

articles.title: How do I book a demo?
articles.text:
Happy to set that up. GrowQR offers demos for recruiters, universities, and companies who want to see the platform in action.
Share your name, work email, organisation, and what you are trying to solve, and I will pass it to our team to arrange a demo. During business hours (IST) I can connect you right away.
You can also request one any time at growqr.ai/contact.

articles.title: How do I contact the GrowQR team?
articles.text:
You can reach the GrowQR team in a few ways.
The fastest is right here. Just say talk to our team and I will connect you during business hours (IST), or take your details for a follow up if we are offline.
You can also use the contact form at growqr.ai/contact, or email support@growqr.ai.

articles.title: How do I improve my RQ Score?
articles.text:
Your RQ Score goes up as your underlying readiness improves, so the fastest way to raise it is to work on the gaps it highlights.
Close skill gaps with RQ-Sage, strengthen your resume and profile with RQ-Mira, practise interviews with RQ-Vera, and build your professional presence with RQ-Nova.
After you work with the agents, re run your RQ Score report to see the change. Paid plans include more frequent reports, up to 12 per quarter on Career Accelerator, so you can track progress over time.

articles.title: How does GrowQR help me switch careers?
articles.text:
GrowQR is well suited to a career switch because it focuses on your readiness for the new field rather than your past title.
Start with your RQ Score to see where you stand for the target role. Use RQ-Sage to close skill gaps, RQ-Lyra to follow a focused learning path, RQ-Mira to reframe your resume, and RQ-Vera to practise interviews for the new field.
Tell me the field you are moving into and I can suggest where to begin.

articles.title: How does the AI Interviewer (RQ-Vera) work?
articles.text:
RQ-Vera puts you through realistic mock interviews before the real one and gives you specific feedback after every session.
On the Free plan you get three mock interviews of five minutes each. The 7-Day Sprint includes eight sessions of ten minutes. Monthly includes sixteen sessions. Career Accelerator adds expert review of your performance plus one to one coaching.
If you have an interview coming up, I can help you choose the plan that fits your timeline.

articles.title: How does the Brand Builder (RQ-Nova) work?
articles.text:
The Brand Builder helps you build your professional presence on LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.
By plan:
• Free: evaluate your Brand Score
• 7-Day Sprint: auto suggestions with manual posting
• Monthly: auto suggestions plus auto posting 4 times a week
• Career Accelerator: auto suggestions plus auto posting 12 times a week, with brand strategy
A stronger presence also contributes to your RQ Score.
Full plan comparison: growqr.ai

articles.title: How does the Learning Curator (RQ-Lyra) work?
articles.text:
The Learning Curator builds a focused learning path for your goal, so you spend time on the right courses.
By plan:
• Free: one free lesson
• 7-Day Sprint: course access with assignments
• Monthly: learning access with assessments and certification
• Career Accelerator: lifetime access
It works alongside the Skill Trainer, which identifies which skill gaps to close first.
Full plan comparison: growqr.ai

articles.title: How does the Opportunity Finder (RQ-Scout) work?
articles.text:
RQ-Scout is your opportunity finder. It understands your goals, matches you to relevant roles, and can apply on your behalf.
On the Free plan it shortlists up to ten jobs. The 7-Day Sprint shortlists and applies to up to twenty. Monthly adds unlimited auto apply, and Career Accelerator has experts manage your applications.
Tell me your target role and location and I can explain how matching works for you.

articles.title: How does the Resume Expert (RQ-Mira) work?
articles.text:
The Resume Expert writes resumes and cover letters tailored to the role you are targeting, built to pass ATS filters.
By plan:
• Free: 1 resume per day and 1 cover letter per day
• 7-Day Sprint: 5 resume templates, plus 5 resumes and 5 cover letters per day
• Monthly: unlimited resumes and cover letters, plus 3 video resumes
• Career Accelerator: unlimited with expert review, plus 9 video resumes
Full plan comparison: growqr.ai

articles.title: How does the Roleplay Coach (RQ-Kai) work?
articles.text:
RQ-Kai lets you practise real world conversations in a safe space, such as salary negotiations, client calls, or difficult workplace situations, and gives you feedback afterwards.
On the Free plan you get three roleplays. The 7-Day Sprint includes eight, Monthly includes sixteen, and Career Accelerator is unlimited with expert review.
Tell me the scenario you want to practise and I can point you to the right plan.

articles.title: How does the Skill Trainer (RQ-Sage) work?
articles.text:
RQ-Sage finds the gaps between your current skills and the role you want, then trains you on the ones that matter most.
It focuses your effort on the skills that actually move your readiness, rather than having you study everything. Your progress shows up in your RQ Score.
It works best alongside RQ-Lyra, which curates the courses and learning to match.

articles.title: How is GrowQR different from ChatGPT?
articles.text:
ChatGPT is a general purpose assistant that answers prompts. GrowQR is built specifically for careers, so instead of one general model you get specialised AI agents that each focus on one job, such as resumes, interviews, skill building, or job matching.
GrowQR also remembers your goals and tracks your progress through your RQ Score, so its guidance is personal and measurable rather than one off answers.
For organisations it works the same way. Role specific AI agents work together through structured workflows instead of a single chatbot handling everything.

articles.title: How is my personal data protected?
articles.text:
GrowQR stores only the information needed to personalise your career guidance.
• Your personal data is not used to train publicly available third-party AI models.
• GrowQR does not sell your personal data.
• Your profile, scores, and verified credentials are shared with an organisation only where you made them visible, or applied to that organisation's posted opportunity.
• Interview and roleplay recordings are kept only as long as needed to give you feedback, and you can delete them at any time in account settings.
• You can request access, correction, or erasure of your data, and withdraw consent, by writing to support@growqr.ai
Full policy: growqr.ai/privacy-policy

articles.title: How is our organisation's data secured?
articles.text:
GrowQR is built for organisational use and operates under India's DPDP Act, 2023.
• Customer and employee data is not used to train publicly available third-party AI models.
• Only the minimum data required to run the platform is collected.
• Safeguards include access controls and encryption in transit, on infrastructure hosted with AWS and Cloudflare.
• Candidate and student profiles, scores, and credentials are visible to your organisation only where the individual made them visible, or applied to your posted opportunity.
• Data is shared with cloud, AI, analytics, and payment vendors only as needed to deliver the service, under contractual protections. GrowQR does not sell personal data.
Full policy: growqr.ai/privacy-policy. For security, compliance, or data residency questions, I can connect you with our team.

articles.title: How much does GrowQR cost for enterprises?
articles.text:
Enterprise pricing is tailored to your organisation rather than a fixed plan, because it depends on which agents you activate and how many people you support.
Tell me your team size and what you want to achieve, whether that is hiring, employee development, or workforce analytics, and I can connect you with our team for pricing and a demo.
For individuals, standard plans start free and are listed at growqr.ai.

articles.title: I could not find what I was looking for
articles.text:
Sorry, I could not find a clear answer for that. A couple of things usually help:
• Try rephrasing in a few words, for example pricing, resume, interviews, RQ Score, or availability in your country.
• Or pick a topic: plans and pricing, AI agents, universities and enterprise, privacy, or billing and refunds.
If you still cannot find it, say talk to our team and I will connect you during business hours (IST), or take your details for a follow up if we are offline.
You can also use growqr.ai/contact or email support@growqr.ai

articles.title: I have a billing or account problem
articles.text:
For anything involving your account, a payment, or a charge, the quickest fix is a human who can look at your specific account, so I will connect you with our team.
During business hours (IST) I can hand you straight to the team. Outside those hours I will take your email and someone will follow up as soon as we are back.
If you can, tell me briefly what is happening so I can pass on the details.

articles.title: What AI agents does GrowQR offer?
articles.text:
GrowQR gives individuals seven specialised AI agents, each focused on one part of your career.
RQ-Scout finds and applies to matched jobs. RQ-Mira builds resumes and cover letters. RQ-Vera runs mock interviews. RQ-Kai coaches you through roleplay practice. RQ-Nova builds your personal brand. RQ-Sage trains your skills. RQ-Lyra curates courses and learning.
You can use a single agent for one need, or combine them for an end to end journey. Each agent has its own page at growqr.ai/agents.
For companies, GrowQR also offers a separate set of enterprise agents for hiring and workforce needs.

articles.title: What are Q-Ryze, Q-Skale, Q-Kampus and Q-Kalyber?
articles.text:
These are GrowQR's four offerings, each built for a different type of user.
• Q-Ryze: for individuals building their own career, including students and working professionals. Start at growqr.ai
• Q-Kalyber: for recruiters and hiring teams. See growqr.ai/solutions/recruiters
• Q-Kampus: for universities and institutes. See growqr.ai/solutions/institutes
• Q-Skale: for businesses and organisations. See growqr.ai/solutions/enterprises
Tell me which one describes you and I can point you to the right place.

articles.title: What do recruiters get from GrowQR?
articles.text:
GrowQR gives recruiters a pipeline of verified, job ready talent and makes screening faster.
RQ-Rita, our AI recruiter, screens and shortlists candidates at scale, and every candidate carries an RQ Score that signals real readiness beyond the resume, so you spend your time on the strongest fits.
You can read more at growqr.ai/solutions/recruiters. If you would like a walkthrough or pricing, I can connect you with our team.

articles.title: What does GrowQR cost? Is it free?
articles.text:
GrowQR has a Free Forever plan at ₹0 with no card required, plus three paid plans.
India pricing:
• 7-Day Sprint: ₹699 one time
• Monthly: ₹1,999 per month
• Career Accelerator: ₹4,999 per quarter (about ₹1,666 per month)
Pricing and availability depend on your region. Where GrowQR is live, plan prices show at checkout. Where it is not yet available, plans show as Coming soon with the option to join the waitlist.
See current pricing for your region at growqr.ai

articles.title: What does GrowQR offer companies and HR teams?
articles.text:
GrowQR Business is an AI workforce platform for hiring and people teams. You activate only the agents you need, with no technical setup.
The enterprise agents are RQ-Rita for recruiting, RQ-Vera for structured interviews, RQ-Scout for talent sourcing, RQ-Nova for employer brand, RQ-Theo for attrition prediction, RQ-Rohan for workforce analytics, RQ-Finn for onboarding, RQ-Eva for capability building, and RQ-Maya for managing outsourced and freelance talent.
If you would like a demo or pricing for your team, I can connect you with our team.

articles.title: What is GrowQR?
articles.text:
GrowQR is an AI powered career platform that helps you build skills, sharpen your profile, and get ready for your next opportunity. It brings together specialised AI agents that each handle one part of your career, from resumes and interviews to skill building, learning, and personal branding.
At the centre is your RQ Score, a readiness score that shows where you stand and what to improve next.
For organisations, GrowQR also offers an AI workforce for hiring, employee development, and workforce analytics.
You can start free at growqr.ai with no card required.

articles.title: What is RQ (Readiness Quotient)?
articles.text:
RQ, or Readiness Quotient, is a score that measures how prepared you are for your next career move. It looks at signals across your skills, profile, experience, and overall readiness and turns them into a clear picture of where you stand.
Along with the score you get specific recommendations on what to improve next, so it works like a readiness health check for your career.
Every plan includes RQ Score reports, and the Free plan includes one free profile report.

articles.title: What is the refund policy?
articles.text:
The full Refund and Cancellation Policy is at growqr.ai/refund-policy
Key points:
• You can cancel an active subscription at any time in your account settings, or by emailing support@growqr.ai. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.
• Refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of the disputed charge.
• Requests are acknowledged within 3 business days and resolved within 15 business days.
• Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 to 10 business days.
For a specific charge, I can connect you with our team.

articles.title: What's included in the Free Forever plan?
articles.text:
The Free Forever plan lets you use GrowQR at ₹0 with no card, and it stays free.
It includes your real time QR identity, one free RQ Score profile report, one verified skill badge, the resume and cover letter builder at one per day, and three five minute mock interviews.
It is a good way to see where you stand. You upgrade only when you want more volume, more agents, or expert help.

articles.title: Which plan is right for me?
articles.text:
It depends on where you are. If you are just exploring, start with Free Forever and run your first RQ Score report.
If you are actively job hunting and want visibility fast, the 7-Day Sprint is a one time ₹699 boost. If you are working toward a goal over several weeks, Monthly at ₹1,999 adds unlimited resumes, auto apply, and a weekly account manager check in.
If you are making an executive move or a full career change, Career Accelerator at ₹4,999 per quarter adds expert reviews and one to one coaching.
Tell me your goal and timeline and I will recommend one.

articles.title: Who is GrowQR for?
articles.text:
GrowQR is built for anyone working on their career, including students, job seekers, working professionals, career switchers, and freelancers who want to build skills and improve how ready they are for opportunities.
It also serves organisations. Universities use it to improve placements, recruiters use it to find job ready talent, and companies use it for hiring and employee development.
Tell me whether you are a student, a professional, a recruiter, a university, or a company, and I can point you to the right place to start.
